gauge.name: Chinle Creek at Chinle

impacts.statement: Flooding to homes and residences in Chinle on left bank downstream from Highway 64 bridge.
Water begins to encroach upon structures just upstream of the Highway 64 bridge near the Canyon de Chelly welcome center.
Chinle Creek becomes impassable to recreational vehicles.
